scope: Implemented opt-in v3 duel experiments. Diagnostic pilots only; rollout rejected, no strength or device qualification.

adoptionDecision.search: not accepted: timing regressions and negative same-tier pilot
adoptionDecision.evaluation: not qualified: positive four-game pilot does not meet full strength/timing/weight-grid gates
adoptionDecision.combined: not accepted: timing regressions, negative same-tier and incremental pilots

fullFlutter.scope: Full run during implementation; final focused checks cover subsequent root-window/cancellation changes and added fixtures

releaseWebBuild.scope: Compilation only, not experimental browser/device responsiveness

verification.localConfiguration: Pre-existing analysis_options.yaml platform/build exclusions were preserved byte-for-byte; no CI workflow or strength threshold changed.

counterexample.scope: Six rotations and two color assignments of one known position; not independent strength openings

proof.scope: Refutes only the recorded ninth-move win, not an eventual game result

heldOutTimingPilot.scope: Three correlated positions per profile/tier; descriptive p95 only. Parameters fixed before holdout; no tuning on these results.

heldOutGamePilots.scope: Same two openings reused across all arms, colors and worker assignments; never count the 40 games as 40 independent openings. Equal-policy target/opponent sweeps are timed repeatability observations, not engine superiority.

balance.scope: Exploratory agent/opening evidence, not perfect-play game balance
balance.confidenceMethod: Opening-cluster percentile bootstrap; 2000 resamples; descriptive, not perfect-play evidence

interpretation: The independent finite-horizon proof establishes avoidable quick losses. Self-play starting shares depend on policy and timed cutoffs; they establish neither intrinsic balance nor stronger defense by themselves. Rules, opening restrictions and randomness defaults are unchanged.
